description: List prediction markets on real-world transport outcomes (flight delays, train punctuality, ship arrivals, weekly ship counts through maritime chokepoints, airport flight counts), filtered by status (OPEN by default; CLOSED, SETTLED or CANCELLED for past ones), category and a free-text query matched against the route, flight number, airline, airport codes and vehicle. Returns total (every market the filters match), returned (how many this page holds: the first limit of them, earliest close time first) and each returned market's id, link, category, question, route, outcomes with current prices, volume, close time and, once settled, the outcome it settled on.

category.description: Filter to one transport category. Omit to get all.

limit.description: Max number of markets to return (1-100). Defaults to the server's page size.

query.description: Free text such as AA1, JFK, Paddington or Suez. Omit to match every market the other filters match.

status.description: Filter by market status: OPEN (trading), CLOSED (awaiting settlement), SETTLED or CANCELLED. Defaults to OPEN.

name: list_markets
title: List prediction markets
